move_edit.move: Only against the caricature. Standpoint epistemology claims defeasible priority for testimony from the affected, not that none but sufferers may speak, so your reversal needs the strong version you conceded was not the real one. On the defeasible version nothing is disqualified, and the priority, cashed, cuts against you: the most affected, taken as a population, largely affirm their lives and have children, so the better-placed witnesses contradict the comfortable antinatalist's evaluative premise. A canon of pessimist authors does not meet that.
